vectors.title: a receipt addressed to another party
spec: specs/trust-ceremony-receipt/0.1/spec.md:150-154 (bearer: no member depends on the receiving party's identity)
SPEC.md:1015 (7.2 item 5: reject a document whose recipient is not the consumer)

vectors.title: a receipt that carries a threadId no step has
spec: SPEC.md:649 (enactment does not replace threadId; threadId scopes one step's exchange)
specs/trust-ceremony-receipt/0.1/spec.md:17-23 (the receipt's parties: recorder issuer, optional verifier recipient)
vectors.clarify: The receipt is not a step of the enactment it reports on and the specification says nothing about its threadId; a verifier should neither need nor require one. Not stated, so not gating.

vectors.title: steps of one enactment that share a single threadId
spec: SPEC.md:649 (threadId scopes one step's request/response exchange; the steps of an enactment are typically siblings)
vectors.clarify: SPEC.md 4.11.2 describes the steps as typically separate exchanges but states no rule on their threadIds, and the verifier rules (spec.md:128-138) do not mention them; a verifier that rejected shared or distinct threads would invent a rule. Not gating.

vectors.title: a receipt whose parentEnactment is its own enactment

specs/trust-ceremony-receipt/0.1/payload.schema.json:21-25 (the receipt's parentEnactment is one level, as on the envelope member)
vectors.clarify: The producer rule is stated for the envelope member (SPEC.md:658) and the receipt's parentEnactment is described as the same member's counterpart; what a verifier does with a receipt that breaks it is not stated.

vectors.title: the same receipt presented twice verifies the same way both times
spec: specs/trust-ceremony-receipt/0.1/spec.md:34 (side effects none: a receipt creates no state at the recipient)
specs/trust-ceremony-receipt/0.1/spec.md:152 (bearer: evidence only its first recipient may act on is not evidence)
SPEC.md:1021 (7.2 item 11 binds the execution of a consequential task)
vectors.clarify: SPEC.md 7.2 item 11 keeps a consequential task from executing twice; verifying a receipt executes nothing, and the receipt's side-effect class is none, but the text does not say a verifier must treat a re-presented receipt as a retry rather than a duplicate. Not gating.
